Rabbit and bird travel basics

This guide covers the main checks before you book pet travel with Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps the process clear and calm, so you know what to prepare before departure.

For rabbit travel, the combined weight of the pet and crate must not exceed 18 kg. Pack the carrier so the animal can stand, turn, and rest without strain, and keep the setup secure for handling.

A bird needs to be at least 15 weeks old before flying. Confirm age before you arrange the trip, and make sure the carrier is safe, clean, and easy to manage at the airport.

If you are traveling with Finn, Aya Johnson, or Talia Moretti, bring any required details with you so the desk can check everything quickly. Our handlers use calm, humane methods and give clear guidance from check-in through departure.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
